about.title: About CreditGPS
about.overview: CreditGPS is an intelligent financial navigation platform that helps eligible Scheduled Caste beneficiaries discover, evaluate, and access government concessional credit schemes. We bridge the gap between government financial assistance programs and the citizens who need them most.
about.problemDesc: The government provides concessional financial assistance through multiple schemes and Channel Partners. However, beneficiaries often struggle to identify suitable schemes, understand eligibility criteria, assess their repayment capacity, find the right Channel Partner, prepare required documentation, and create project reports. The existing process is fragmented and confusing.
about.missionDesc: To democratize access to government credit schemes by providing an intelligent, transparent, and accessible platform that guides every citizen through the complete loan journey — from scheme discovery to application submission.
about.feature1: AI-powered conversational navigator that understands your needs in English and Hindi
about.feature2: Deterministic eligibility engine — no guesswork, transparent rule-based decisions
about.feature3: EMI calculator, financial health analyzer, and what-if simulator
about.feature4: Intelligent Channel Partner routing based on fund availability, proximity, and efficiency
about.aiDesc: CreditGPS uses AI to understand your financial needs through natural conversation, extract structured information from your queries, and explain recommendations in simple language. Importantly, the AI never makes eligibility decisions — those are handled by our deterministic rule engine for complete transparency and accountability.
about.disclaimerDesc: CreditGPS is a decision-support and information platform. It does not guarantee loan approval, disbursement, or any financial outcome. All scheme details, eligibility criteria, and partner information are provided for guidance only. Final decisions rest with the respective Channel Partners and government authorities. Users should verify all information with official sources before proceeding with applications.
